item.title: Painted City 1.5
item.description:
Three new painting styles: Cubism and Cubism Monotone (houses bent out of true, like a naive hill-town painting) and Expressionism (oil paint: brush daubs that follow the forms, thick strokes lit like real paint).

Screen Print: no more orange specks in the shade around trees and windows, and rooftop signs print as whole letters.

Experimental: painted trees, a switch in the … menu.
